description: One row per customer order. Links customers to their purchases. Tracks order status and total value.

columns.order_id: Primary key — unique identifier for each order (INTEGER or UUID)
columns.customer_id: Foreign key linking to customers.customer_id (INTEGER or UUID)
columns.total_amount: Total value of the order in USD (NUMERIC). Sum of all order_items subtotals.
columns.created_at: Timestamp when the order was placed (TIMESTAMPTZ)
columns.shipped_at: Timestamp when the order was shipped — NULL if not yet shipped (TIMESTAMPTZ)
columns.delivered_at: Timestamp when the order was delivered — NULL if not yet delivered (TIMESTAMPTZ)

sample_questions: What is the total revenue this month?
How many orders were placed each day last week?
What percentage of orders are currently in 'pending' status?
